LD proxies

Source: R/ld-proxies.R
og_ld_proxies.Rd

og_ld_proxies() finds the variants in LD with each of variants: every variant within kb kilobases whose r² with it is at least r2, strongest first. It is an LD lookup, for questions about LD itself. It never substitutes one variant's Associations for another's (see vignette("ld")).

Usage

og_ld_proxies(src, variants, ld = NULL, r2 = 0.8, kb = 10000)

Arguments

src

A Source, from og_api().

variants

ALIDs and rsIDs, or a data frame of Associations.

ld

An LD Store's name, an ancestry code (its LD Store), or NULL to match the Assigned Ancestry of the Associations' Analyses. LD Stores only: a PLINK Reference is refused.

r2

The smallest r² of a proxy.

kb

The window, in kilobases either side of the variant.

Value

A data frame with og_provenance() attached (ld, ld_choice, absent), one row per proxy: alid, proxy_alid, r (signed, for the first alleles of both), r2 and distance (base pairs). Ordered by alid as asked, then by r² (strongest first).

Details

variants and ld are as for og_ld_matrix(); an LD Store can only be named, not a PLINK Reference. Variants the LD Store doesn't hold have no proxies, and give a warning of class opengwasr_ld_absent_variants. The API refuses an r2 and kb the LD Store can't answer exactly (opengwasr_ld_refusal, with reason, t_far, near_bp and far_bp). One Job takes at most 1,000 variants; more are split.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
src <- og_api()
px <- og_ld_proxies(src, "16:53767042:C:T", ld = "EUR")
head(px)
} # }
